| description = Zarchoomi spawns to the NW of 15 on the Butcherblock Mountains map between western wall and rock pillar on the north side of the goblin camp.  Upon spawning, she or her PH will stand stationary for a bit before wandering south towards the two dwarf houses near the GFay zoneline.

She wanders, so if you do not see her, kill everything in the area and then sit at the spawn point for the respawn. You can also wait at the spawn point and she or the PH will path back to the location after several minutes. Location has been confirmed by Barkclaw on Green (3/14/26): she spawned twice during 37 consecutive spawn cycles at loc -135, -2030.
